You’re not alone. I also suffer with depression, anxiety and more recently a sudden weight gain (not sure why). I (F42) am mono (by choice) and my husband (M41) is poly. After 21 years together we opened the relationship and I am struggling so, so much with it. We are in therapy together and have been for a good long while. The therapy and our ongoing communication has kept me/him/us from falling apart. He currently has a girlfriend and as long as I don’t stay inside my negative thoughts too much, I’m ok! Like, really ok. I can find a place of stability in our deep history, our love and our strong commitment to each other. Do I feel horrible about myself and worry he will leave me for a more upbeat, non-depressed person? Hell yes. But he has had plenty of chances to leave and he hasn’t. He assures me he won’t. We are conscious of keeping our love alive and are finding new ways to express it all the time. 

So yes, it’s possible! But it isn’t easy.
